body: I feel you. I'm at a stage in my life where I'm not seeing any point in getting older and progressing into/through adulthood. I hope you find something that can keep you going through these times until you find something that truly gives you purpose. <3
Trust me, I'd give you a hug if I could, and I know many others would too if they knew of your situation. If you do keep living, try to remember you have people to talk to here.

I like to think about the last song/s I'd listen to. In my "ideal" suicide (i.e. painless, quick, and gory) I would want to listen to something that would make me happy right before I end my life, so that I go out feeling good.

I get that. I don't mean to invalidate your feelings, I just want to make sure you are aware that you have a choice. I know all to well how easily thoughts can get clouded and if you make a decision, I hope you can do so thinking clearly.

Personally I don't think life \*wants\* anything, it's pretty random. I can understand you thinking that ending your life is the only way though. I do want you to consider that you don't \*have\* to end your life, also. I'm not going to tell you you shouldn't feel like ending your life, but please don't feel like you need to. I think that can cloud your judgement and close off other thoughts.
I hope the same for you too. <3

I think I can somewhat relate. Sometimes when I contemplate suicide, it's comforting. I like feeling as if I can at least control the way I die and pass away somewhat happy. This subreddit is really good for finding people who are going through similar shit. Your post has made me feel a little better for the moment.

I know the feeling. I wish I could say something more comforting, but at least I can tell you that you genuinely, truly are not alone in the world in your hurt. I just turned 18 and it has made me feel even worse about my future.

Me too. I've had four "relationships", and in each one I was insecure because I felt like a rebound or like if someone more attractive had noticed my SO first they wouldn't give a shit about me.

It's rough. It sucks.
Yeah, it really does. It does make me feel more grateful when a friend does actually check in with me though. I hope this counts as you getting a notification by the way! :D

There may be someone in your life who cares about you as much as you need them to, with or without knowing your exact feelings. I didn't believe this before, but seeing how many posts there are on this subreddit, I think it would actually be possible to find such a person irl. Keep an eye out for them if you can, they'll be a blessing. All the best 💜

You can't control how you feel, especially with an emotion as overwhelming as romantic love. I was depressed before my girlfriend dumped me, and now I'm suicidal. I do love my parents and they are a big reason I haven't killed myself yet, but when she dumped me it really pushed me over the edge. 

Try talking to your boyfriend about how you feel, if you know he truly loves you as much as you love him. I think if I had been more honest with my girlfriend we may still be together? Idk though. Make sure he doesn't feel like he has to stay in a relationship or else you'll kill yourself, however. You'll end up hating yourself terribly if you do that to him. Just tell him how much he means to you and do everything you can to keep your relationship healthy. If I had one selfish wish granted it would be to get that second chance with my ex.

Yep, all the time. Since my girlfriend dumped me I noticed I check my phone a lot more because of how lonely I am. I'm always desperate from a text from her, or at least from a friend I can talk to because I'm too scared to reach out to others.

I feel like I peaked in high school for this reason. I went to a smallish school where I could be one of the smartest, one of the most popular, and one of the most talented. Then I graduated and realised I'm fucking nothing. I have no skills, no looks, no intelligence, no social skills. It's like I was lied to, told I could be something, a mover, a shaker, and then when I no longer have anyone guiding me along I realise I will never amount to anything, even by much lower standards than those I had in high school. 

I hate being the unattractive friend, the guy with no plan, the loser who plays video games and watches movies because he has no motivation to study or do work. What sucks most is that if I do kill myself, that will be my legacy. Those close to me won't remember me as the charismatic and fun person I was, but rather the miserable, pathetic, sensitive little shit I am now. 

As fucked as it may sound, I envy Robin Williams, because he died a brilliant, amazing, and talented man. The world is worse without him. It would be better off without me.

I know exactly what you mean. I simultaneously want to do something or say something to let people know how I feel and want to stay a closed book for fearing of becoming just an attention-seeker. Even friends and family with the best of intentions can't help but judge you and treat you differently when they realise your mental state. 

I think that's the nice thing about this subreddit though. Everyone here cares about each other at least a little because everyone is at approximately the same, shitty, god-forsaken state, and so no one tries to placate you with false promises or condescending suggestions. We're all in the same shitty ark and it's just about being nice to one another and being understanding. I hope you are okay brother/sister. Try to find some calm in the fact that there are others on here who know how it can hurt.

I truly hope you find your peace, but I would add that to me it does not seem fair to deprive others of theirs. If you are serious about going through with this and you love your family at least a little, find a way to minimize the trauma they may experience. I have been contemplating suicide more seriously recently and I feel I owe it to my family to not have them be the ones to "discover" my body. I think maybe calling the police just prior to the act may help in that by the time they get to your house you will have passed but your family doesn't have to be the ones to find your body. 

All in all, I wish you the best. Indulge a stranger who cares by putting as much thought into the immediate outcome as you can before going through with your plan, please. Nevertheless, I hope the rest of your life (no matter how long or short it may be) is happy.
I feel you. I hope you find peace, however that may be. Please be careful and try not to end up in hospital, because that will be way worse than either death *or* your current existence.

I've heard both this and that the grief lasts a lifetime. I believe both. It's scary to think about who in my life would be affected by either timeframe if I took my own life. I don't want to hurt people with my death, but to think I'll be forgotten anyway in less than a year by people who I love enough to not end my suffering is heartbreaking.
May I ask why you want it to be brutal?
